title: iniBuilds Global Jet Release Date Confirmed – November 24th
summary: iniBuilds has confirmed that its highly anticipated Global Jet will arrive on the Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Marketplace on November 24th, 2026. The announcement was made during a live demonstration showcasing the aircraft's advanced avionics and systems.
body:
The wait is almost over! iniBuilds has announced that its highly anticipated **Global Jet will be released on Tuesday, November 24th, 2026**, through the Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Marketplace.

The announcement appeared during the developer's live demonstration on November 20th, with an on-screen banner confirming the Marketplace release date.

Based on the **Bombardier Global 6000**, the iniBuilds Global Jet promises to bring an advanced long-range business aviation experience to MSFS 2024, combining sophisticated avionics, detailed aircraft systems and an interactive luxury cabin.

## Advanced Vision Flight Deck

![](/assets/GlexTrailer1.png)

At the heart of the Global Jet is a customised Vision Flight Deck, incorporating an extensive range of flight planning, navigation and aircraft management capabilities.

Features announced by iniBuilds include:

- SimBrief flight plan integration
- Secondary flight plans and multi-destination planning
- Fully integrated VNAV with speed and altitude management
- Takeoff and landing performance calculations
- Head-Up Display (HUD) with synthetic vision
- Integrated weather radar with vertical weather display
- CPDLC communications through supported services, including Hoppie, SayIntentions and BeyondATC
- Dedicated steep approach mode

These features should make the aircraft particularly appealing to virtual business jet pilots undertaking both short repositioning flights and long-range international operations.

## Detailed Aircraft Systems

iniBuilds has placed considerable emphasis on the aircraft's systems modelling.

The Global Jet features interconnected electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic and fuel systems, alongside EPR-based engine and autothrottle modelling.

Nine system synoptic displays allow pilots to monitor aircraft operation, while the integrated Electronic Flight Bag provides access to performance calculations, payload management, system information and additional flight management tools.

An electronic checklist system also responds to aircraft caution and warning messages.

## An Interactive Luxury Cabin

![](/assets/GlexTrailer7.png)

Beyond the flight deck, the Global Jet offers two fully interactive cabin configurations: Classic and Futuristic.

Both interiors feature walkable cabins, animated furnishings, adjustable lighting and interactive passenger amenities.

Cabin modes include Boarding and Rest & Relax, with corresponding changes to lighting, window shades and cabin presentation.

## Authentic Engine Sounds

Audio specialist Echo19 has recorded the real aircraft's Rolls-Royce BR710 engines using multiple microphones.

These recordings have been incorporated into a detailed sound environment covering the cockpit, passenger cabin and exterior.

The sound package also includes electrical relays, cooling fans, hydraulic operation and other aircraft-specific effects.

## Release Date and Availability

**Confirmed Marketplace release date: Tuesday, November 24th, 2026.**

The date was revealed during the November 20th iniBuilds livestream.

At the time of writing, pricing and any separate release arrangements through the iniBuilds Store have not been confirmed in the information available to BizJet Pilot.

## BizJet Pilot's View

The Global Jet is shaping up to be one of the most interesting business aviation releases for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024.

Its combination of advanced flight management, long-range capability, detailed systems and interactive cabin features makes it particularly attractive for pilots who enjoy realistic executive aviation operations.

With the release now just days away, we are looking forward to seeing how the aircraft performs in the simulator.

**BizJet Pilot will continue following developments as the November 24th release approaches.**
